about: Hand-worked scenarios for POD.state (docs/state-contract.md, D-031). Expected values are worked by hand in each `work` (closed-form meridian distances, the engine contract's formulas), never copied from state.js. Run a scenario like this: D = a deep copy of datasets[data], with `patch` replacing whole top-level keys; now = new Date(step.now || doc.now), a local date-time with no zone (JS reads it as local time, so a period never depends on the machine's time zone); steps run in order on one S. `fresh` and `load` create S (it replaces the current one); every other call takes S. `signatures` gives each call's arguments: "*" is the step's `args` spread in place, S the current state, D the scenario's dataset, now as above, opts the step's `opts` (default undefined), storage the scenario's storage. `returns`, when present, is the expected return value. Then each `expect` key is checked: a plain key is a dotted path into S (array indexes allowed, e.g. credits.0.used); $missing, $appMissing.<app>, $forEngine (null or not), $forEngine.<path> ("$absent" = no such key), $calc.<channel>.<field> (POD.engine.calc on forEngine(S)), $allResults.ids (POD.engine.allResults(forEngine(S)) ids in order), $getPath.<path> (getPath; "$undefined" means undefined), $saved.<path> / $savedKeys (the object save wrote, "$absent" = not there), $has.<path> (the path exists in S), $storageWrites (setItem calls), $protoClean (Object.prototype gained nothing). storage: memory (a Map-backed getItem/setItem; `value` is the initial string), throwing (both methods throw), none (storage is null). Numbers compare exactly.
datasetsAbout: S1: fixture values, not claims about the world. NY ZIPs 10001-10007 sit on longitude -74 at latitudes 40.000, 40.010, ... 40.060; MT ZIPs 20001-20007 on -110 at 45.000 ... 45.060. Tile 40_-74: Burger Co (bg) at 40.100; Pizza Co (pz) at 40.030 and 40.050, all on -74. Along a meridian, miles = 69.094094428 x degrees. Speed 30 mph. pz is profiled (dd 20%, ue 25%; a pickup deal: 2 flagged items at $15 each); bg is unprofiled (burger default 15%); xx's category has no default, so it can't be priced. gh's fees are null.

scenarios.work: Bad types fall back to fresh: tipDel string, tipPick < 0, speed 0, fuel jet, brand 42, dd.svc < 0, memberOwn 'yes', store lat string, ue promo type bogo (the type alone falls back; value 5 is a valid number and stays). member and markup are derived, never loaded. cards keeps the strings, then syncCredits prunes c_zz and the duplicate. cart keeps only canonical keys with integer qty >= 0. The saved pos is a ZIP position (not GPS), so it's ignored, and derive re-derives pos from the address. manualCredits keeps the first valid manual.1. mpg and miles may be null. Unknown fields and apps are dropped. load never writes to storage.
